goal: Create a dormant, additive registry that seals immutable Raider.IO player snapshots, deterministically projects them through local Talent and Gear authorities, publishes complete 80-slot TemplateSets with same-slot LKG, and changes only a generation-guarded candidate pointer.
userValue: Talent and equipment simulation can later consume one stable, auditable real-player template identity per Hero slot without making every source refresh a fragile full release-chain rewrite.
nonGoals: No Raider.IO network collector, existing-cache backfill or scheduled refresh
No public or candidate API reader and no change to active observed-only payloads
No first production TemplateSet activation, old Release/Manifest mutation or Community Release replacement
No frontend, health/admin, timer, SimC submission or runtime dependency installation

mustChange: Seal content-addressed real-player snapshots without putting checkedAt in immutable identity.
Build dependency-complete deterministic Talent and Gear projections that are either verified/importable or blocked with structured problems.
Build exactly 80 unique class/spec/hero/scenario entries, retaining only the same slot's last verified projection when a replacement is blocked.
Persist snapshots, checks, projections and TemplateSets additively with immutable rows, row hashes, restricted foreign keys and minimal wow_app grants.
Move and roll back only an isolated TemplateSet pointer through monotonic compare-and-swap generations.
mustNotChange: Canonical Talent authority, Gear Resolver and SimC serializer/runtime ownership
Observed-only public entry, exact community import and baseline-empty semantics
Existing Release/Manifest pointer, sync orchestration, timer/backflow behavior and frontend routes
riskUnknown: A malformed direct SQL write could mix a slot with the wrong snapshot or projection unless pure validation, row hashes and foreign keys remain aligned.
Concurrent pointer writers must fail closed on a stale generation and rollback must never rewrite immutable artifacts.
evidenceRequired: Pure deterministic identity, dependency drift, 80-slot uniqueness, same-slot LKG and pending-state tests
PG migration schema, append-only grants, exact row-hash reuse, CAS conflict and rollback tests
Dormant end-to-end shadow proof covering generations 1, 2 and 3 without live or legacy dependencies
Final candidate commit/tree, database backup, additive migration, isolated-scope seal/CAS/rollback smoke and old-reader non-activation
Full Harness profile, whole-branch local CR, timer/backflow non-activation and code/data rollback targets

ownership.factOwner: server/observed_build_registry.py owns immutable observation identity; server/observed_build_projection.py owns deterministic projection; server/observed_build_template_set.py owns 80-slot LKG policy; server/observed_build_store.py owns all new SQL.

engineeringHealth.reason: The slice introduces an immutable PG schema and a mutable CAS pointer, but deliberately has no runtime reader, network collector, public payload or SimC consumer. Candidate migration and isolated rollback proof are still required.

acceptanceEvidence: Targeted pure, store, schema, public-contract and exact-import regression suite
Strict Harness full profile on the exact final candidate head
Candidate database backup plus isolated dormant registry seal, CAS conflict and rollback smoke
Runtime inspection proving public readers, existing active Manifest pointer and timers were not activated or changed

decisionLog.decision: The user approved replacing the long player-scan release chain with immutable snapshots, deterministic local projection and atomic 80-slot TemplateSets.
If a newly observed player cannot map, the exact slot continues using its previous verified template and is marked stale; the other 79 slots continue normally.
When Rank 1 changes from player A to player B and B verifies, the slot may switch automatically while dependency revisions remain unchanged.
This first implementation is restricted to the core path and dormant candidate proof; collection, backfill, public readers and SimC integration are deferred.
